summary: PawHaus VIP Portal A/B - first iteration. 17/17 backend pytest tests pass (catalog, code validation, quote math incl. $349/$889/$1398.40, Stripe session creation+persistence, status polling, VIP one-time-per-email guard, invalid webhook signature). Frontend e2e via Playwright: landing two-lane funnel renders, PAWVIP unlock navigates to /booking with VIP 50% badge, invalid code shows error with fallback link, public CTA navigates with 20% PUBLIC badge, 3-step flow works, SummaryCard live-updates ($349 for VIP standard WEEKDAY_1N matches backend), and Pay Securely button SUCCESSFULLY REDIRECTS to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... confirming end-to-end Stripe integration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 13: emergentintegrations import is at top-level — if the package were unavailable the entire app would crash. Acceptable here since it is required, but consider try/except for clearer error.

server.py: `logger` is referenced inside stripe_webhook (line 333) but defined later at line 382. If a webhook exception happens before module finishes loading it would NameError. In practice it works because module finishes loading first, but order should be fixed (move logging.basicConfig + logger above route definitions).
Booking.jsx: `useEffect` is imported but not used (line 1) — minor lint noise.
BookingContext persists `guests` (incl. email/phone) to localStorage indefinitely. Consider a TTL/clear-on-success for PII hygiene.
VIP repeat-block currently only checks email — a user could rebook VIP using a different email. Acceptable for the demo PAWVIP code, but worth noting.
test_credentials: VIP code: PAWVIP. No auth required.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings/transactions created with TEST_ email prefix and cleaned up after each test. One synthetic 'paid' VIP txn inserted directly into payment_transactions to validate the repeat-block guard, then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_pawhaus_api.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_pawhaus_api.py -v`. Stripe sk_test_emergent in /app/backend/.env is functional and returns real test-mode checkout.stripe.com URLs that successfully load Stripe's hosted checkout. The 'pawhaus_booking_v1' localStorage key persists tier+room+stay+guests across reloads. One transient timeout was observed on a page.reload() during a persistence smoke test but a subsequent fresh navigation to /booking still showed the correct badge — likely flaky preview-env load, not a bug.
